verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://documentation.datalab.to/llms.txt, which serves a structured Datalab Documentation index linking to .md pages. Several docs pages are also published as raw .md files (webhooks.md, cli.md, pipelines.md, API reference .md), which gives agents machine-readable, agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-usage guidance, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
